column2: A side-hinged casement window opens outward from its frame, with its glass panel, latch and side hinges clearly visible.
Rot spreads across an apple, with a dark soft patch expanding around a wound and shriveled flesh beneath.
A heavy round iron cannonball rests beside a historical cannon wheel, with no fuse, explosive diagram or firing action.
A horse canters smoothly across a paddock, with its rider balanced lightly and the animal's three-beat gait suggested naturally.
A modest cantina has a wooden drinks counter, stools and several adult patrons conversing beside unbranded bottles.
Two young goats caper around a rock, kicking their hind legs into the air with playful energy.
A business owner's invested capital takes the form of machinery, tools and stored materials inside a productive small workshop.
Four coworkers carpool to work in one small car, with their separate work bags arranged beside the shared seats.
A turtle's domed carapace is shown from above, displaying fitted shell scutes while the head and feet extend naturally.
A small sailboat careens sideways in a gust, its mast leaning sharply while the sailor braces against the tilted deck.
A carport has a simple roof on four posts, sheltering a car while all four sides remain open.
A library carrel encloses one quiet reading seat with three low partitions, a desk lamp and an open reference book.
A large wooden cartwheel has a metal rim, thick spokes and a central axle hub beside a simple farm cart.
A cataclysmic earthquake splits a broad valley floor, displacing roads and collapsing empty buildings, with no injured people shown.
A sailing catamaran has two separate parallel hulls linked by a broad deck beneath a single central mast.
A small dish of red ketchup sits beside fried potatoes, with a spoon leaving a thick glossy streak.
A model walks along a narrow raised catwalk between two rows of seated spectators, keeping the runway's length visible.
A worker fills the gap around a window frame with sealant, guiding a caulking nozzle along the joint.
A fresh smooth caulking bead seals the corner between a bathtub and wall, with a sealant gun resting nearby.
A tiny sandy cay rises above shallow turquoise water, with a few low shrubs and exposed coral rubble.
Opposing soldiers observe a ceasefire, lowering their weapons on opposite sides of an undisturbed boundary while envoys meet between them.
An animator holds a transparent painted animation cel above a separate background sheet, with registration holes visible along its edge.
A mythological centaur has a human upper torso joined naturally to a horse's body, standing with all four hooves visible.
A forestry worker uses a chainsaw on a firmly supported fallen log, wearing protective equipment and keeping bystanders distant.
A chalky stone leaves a pale powdery trace on a dark surface, with crumbly dust collected beneath the broken edge.
A chamois stands on a rocky slope, with short backward-hooked horns, dark facial stripes and a compact tan body.
A wide level plain extends toward a low horizon, with grasses and a small distant tree establishing the open scale.
An archival chancery stores official documents in orderly cabinets, with a clerk carefully filing a sealed roll of records.
A bunch of chard displays broad crinkled green leaves and thick brightly colored stalks, lying beside a garden basket.
A charming storyteller captivates a small group, smiling warmly while listeners lean forward and laugh with delight.
An adult chastens a child who damaged a chair, firmly requiring them to help repair the broken leg.
A French-style chateau has a grand central entrance, steep roofs, corner turrets and a formal garden before its facade.
A chatty passenger talks animatedly to a seatmate, gesturing enthusiastically while the listener tries politely to follow.
An extreme nationalist waves an oversized plain national banner, dismissing other nations' small banners with a contemptuous gesture.
A vendor lowers an item's price by removing several coins from its displayed coin pile, leaving the item unchanged.
A card-game cheater secretly slips an extra card from a sleeve, while unsuspecting companions concentrate on the table.
An officer inspects personnel lined up in a row, comparing the assembled group with an attendance clipboard.
A cheerless waiting room has gray walls, a broken lamp and an empty flower vase beneath a rainy window.
An empty chessboard has eight alternating light and dark squares along each edge, with no pieces or lettering.
A black-capped chickadee perches on a twig, with a black cap and bib, white cheeks and gray wings.
A narrow chink between two wooden planks lets a thin shaft of sunlight enter an otherwise shaded shed.
Folded chino cloth shows a sturdy tan cotton twill weave, with one corner turned back to reveal its underside.
A chipper adult greets a sleepy neighbor with a bright smile, upright posture and an energetic wave.
Two neighbors share casual chit-chat over tea, smiling and gesturing comfortably across a small kitchen table.
A chivalrous knight dismounts to help a traveler cross a muddy path, offering an armored hand without condescension.
A hungry pony chomps a mouthful of hay, showing a large visible bite held between its broad lips.
A chooser thoughtfully selects one apple from a basket, comparing its surface with another apple held in the opposite hand.
A church choir sings a hymn together, standing with matching songbooks before a simple altar and no readable lyrics.
A choreographer demonstrates a dance step to three performers, indicating their exact positions across the rehearsal floor.
A small steam locomotive makes rhythmic chugging puffs, with separate steam bursts rising above its short chimney.
A child munches noisily on a large crunchy biscuit, holding it in both hands while crumbs fall onto a plate.
A spoon lifts chunky fruit chutney from a small jar, showing thick sauce and visible cooked fruit pieces beside a meal.
Two friends greet each other at a cafe doorway, smiling and lifting their hands in a relaxed welcoming wave.
A rider tightens a saddle's girth beneath a calm horse, pulling the strap through its buckle beside the saddle flap.
A cinematographer operates a film camera on a tripod, checking the actor's framing while a focus assistant waits nearby.
A camera crew carefully lights and films one staged scene, with a camera, reflector and actor aligned in a compact setup.
A glacial cirque forms a bowl-shaped hollow beneath steep mountain walls, with a small tarn at its lower center.
Thin wispy cirrus clouds streak high across a clear sky, with delicate feather-like strands and no dense rain clouds.
A small fortified city-state has its own palace, harbor and enclosing boundary, with open countryside beyond its independent walls.
A civics teacher explains a model council chamber to students, using citizen figures and a simple ballot box on the desk.
A loose wooden shutter clacks against its frame in the wind, with small impact marks at the contact edge.
Two matching halves of a clam shell lie open, showing rounded ridged outer surfaces and smooth pale inner faces.
A heavy loose chain clanks against a metal gate, with several links striking the bars as the gate swings.
One spectator claps enthusiastically with both hands while a musician bows, making the applauding person's action unmistakable.
Members of a community share one level circular table equally, with identical chairs and no elevated seat or privileged place.
A close view of a keyboard shows alternating long white keys and shorter raised black keys, with one hand poised above.
Clerks exchange grouped checks between bank trays at a clearing house, balancing the incoming and outgoing document bundles.
A judge shows clemency by releasing a remorseful minor offender from restraints, while the offender bows their head gratefully.
An acrobat reaches the climactic peak of a performance atop a tall balanced stack, with spectators leaning forward in anticipation.
A climatologist compares many years of weather charts beside tree-ring samples and a globe, using long-term records rather than a daily forecast.
A humid tropical landscape has lush plants, frequent rain and warm mist, with the climatic conditions dominating the scene.
A wooden clothespin grips a wet towel on a clothesline, showing its spring and opposing jaws clearly.
A mother hen clucks softly toward her nearby chicks, lowering her head with a briefly opened beak.
An old clunker car has dented panels, rust patches and a loose bumper, with smoke puffing from its stalled engine.
An awkward heavy shoe has an oversized thick sole and bulky stiff upper, making its wearer's step visibly cumbersome.
Two co-defendants stand together before the same judge, each beside counsel while one shared case folder lies on the bench.
Two co-owners jointly hold keys to one shop, standing together beneath its plain awning with equal welcoming poses.
Two actors co-star in a stage scene, sharing the central spotlight while facing each other in equal leading positions.
An elaborate coiffure arranges long hair into a neat braided updo, shown from behind above a simple neckline.
A bowl of coleslaw contains finely shredded cabbage and carrot in a creamy dressing, with a serving fork alongside.
A collapsible camping chair is partly folded, revealing its crossed hinge structure between a full seat and compact carrying shape.
A colliery entrance leads into a coal seam, with a mine cart, pithead machinery and black coal piled nearby.
A colonial administrator plants a foreign flag on occupied land, directing resource crates outward while local residents are excluded from the gate.
An enormous stone colossus towers over tiny visitors, its complete human figure standing beside a temple entrance.
A columbine flower shows five backward-projecting spurs and delicate nodding petals above rounded divided leaves.
A comic actor performs a harmless pratfall beside an oversized prop chair, prompting visible laughter from the audience.
An attractive adult smiles naturally beside a window, with balanced features, ordinary clothing and a relaxed unexaggerated pose.
A teacher recommends a talented apprentice to an employer, proudly presenting the apprentice's carefully finished workpiece.
A logistics officer organizes food crates and uniforms for troops, checking supplies beside a military storehouse cart.
Two neighbors exchange a basket of apples for a basket of eggs, each handing their goods across the fence.
Three short chains are joined end to end into one longer chain, with a hand closing the final connector link.
Two independent measuring tapes indicate the same board length, with their marked endpoints aligned exactly and no readable numerals.
Condensed water droplets collect beneath a cold metal lid, with a few larger drops falling into a clean receiving bowl.
Leaders of three neighboring settlements form an alliance, joining hands around one map while distinct plain flags stand together behind them.
Two close friends sit comfortably on a bench, one listening sympathetically while the other shares a personal concern.
A conformist copies the exact uniform arrangement of the surrounding group, adjusting their hat to match everyone's identical angle.
A congregation gathers in a simple church, all facing the same speaker from rows of equally spaced pews.
A conifer branch carries several mature woody cones among its narrow needles, with one cone open to reveal overlapping scales.
A conservancy worker protects a young tree with a fence, keeping grazing animals away from the vulnerable sapling.
Two conspirators whisper over a secret plan in a locked room, hiding it beneath a cloth when footsteps approach.
An inventor presents a new compact fruit-picking contraption, with a telescoping pole and gentle claw lifting an apple.
A recovering patient rests in a sunny garden chair, taking a short supported walk after leaving the nearby sickbed.
A convalescent adult practices gentle walking with a caregiver, moving slowly beside a bench and folded recovery blanket.
A skilled conversationalist draws quiet guests into a lively discussion, listening warmly and inviting another person to speak.
Friends prepare a cookout around an outdoor grill, with vegetables, plates and a picnic table arranged safely nearby.
A raccoon stands beside a stream, displaying its black facial mask, ringed tail and dexterous forepaws around a small stone.
A copycat child exactly imitates another child's unusual block tower, glancing sideways to match each added piece.
A copyist carefully transcribes a manuscript by hand, with the original page on a stand beside the new sheet.
Several linked mountain ranges form a long cordillera, with parallel ridges and deep connecting valleys shown from above.
Corduroy fabric folds over a chair, revealing its distinct parallel raised ribs and soft pile texture in close view.
A corkscrew's metal spiral enters a wine cork, with the wooden handle held firmly above the bottle neck.
An old-fashioned performer repeats a stale stage gag with a rubber chicken, while the audience looks weary rather than amused.
A muddy shoe print corroborates a suspect's matching boot, with an investigator aligning the sole beside the clear impression.
A compact naval corvette sails in profile, with a low military hull, modest superstructure and deck equipment but no firing.
Two people sign the same formal document side by side, with the second pen poised at an adjacent signature line.
A cosmonaut floats outside an orbital capsule in a pressure suit, attached by a tether beside the open hatch.
Two local businesses jointly sponsor a community sports event, each contributing equipment crates beside the same playing field.
A deep dry canyon cuts through a plateau, with steep eroded walls and a narrow floor winding between them.
A councillor participates in a town council meeting, studying a local park model while seated among elected colleagues.
A fencer parries an incoming thrust and immediately counterattacks, extending their foil toward the opponent's padded torso.
A shopkeeper installs flood barriers as a countermeasure against rising street water, keeping the shop's interior visibly dry.
A military court hears a uniformed defendant before uniformed judges, with counsel and a case folder in the chamber.
A dishonest worker conceals a broken vase beneath a tablecloth, arranging intact objects above it to hide the damage.
A light coverlet lies over a bed's thicker blanket, with its thin fabric folded back at one corner.
A simple cowl drapes over a figure's head and shoulders, its deep hood framing the otherwise neutral face.
An eccentric inventor proudly presents a bicycle with square wheels, ignoring the obvious difficulty of riding it over flat ground.
A steep rugged crag rises sharply above a mountain path, with angular exposed rock and sparse plants in its crevices.
Steel crampons strap beneath mountaineering boots, with several sharp downward points gripping a small patch of ice.
A crankshaft rests on a workshop stand, showing its offset crankpins, bearing journals and counterweights along one rotating axis.
A very poor-quality chair has crooked legs, splintered wood and a loose seat that sags under a light cushion.
An insensitive guest ignores a companion's grief, cheerfully displaying party decorations beside the companion's wilted memorial flowers.
A cowardly guard hides behind a small stool when a harmless kitten enters, leaving others to approach it calmly.
A freshwater crayfish stands on stream gravel, showing two large claws, segmented tail and long antennae beneath clear shallow water.
A creaky door hangs on an old rusty hinge, with the opening edge vibrating slightly as a person pushes it.
A tray of young cress plants has slender pale stems and paired rounded green seed leaves growing close together.
A hand moves a brush in intersecting horizontal and vertical strokes across a board, producing a clear crisscross lattice.
A small woodland critter peeks from beneath a log, with a squirrel's complete furry body, paws and tail visible.
A frog croaks beside a pond, with its throat sac inflated beneath an open mouth and forefeet planted on a leaf.
A collection of ceramic crockery includes plates, bowls and a teapot, arranged together on a simple kitchen shelf.
A tenant farmer cultivates a field beside a distant landlord's manor, with rent grain sacks waiting at the field gate.
Two opposing gun positions direct intersecting lines of fire across an empty crossroads, shown schematically without people, impacts or injuries.
A long plank lies sideways across a narrow path, its broad crosswise placement blocking the forward walking direction.
A crosswise wooden brace joins two upright posts, running horizontally across their vertical alignment in one clear fence section.
A steel crowbar has a curved forked end levering a nail from a board, with its long shaft fully visible.
A vineyard covers a sunny hillside in straight rows, with trellised grape vines carrying clusters beneath their leaves.
Thick dirty crud clings to the underside of a neglected sink drain, with a cleaning brush held beside it.
A cheap sandwich has stale uneven bread and a meager filling, served on a flimsy plate with a cracked edge.
A crystallographer compares faceted crystals with a three-dimensional lattice model, using a hand lens beside the laboratory workstation.
An original Cubist still life breaks a guitar and bowl into intersecting angular planes, showing several viewpoints in one coherent painting.
A cow calmly chews regurgitated cud in a pasture, with a small cud bolus visible between its lips and no graphic detail.
A soft stuffed rabbit looks inviting to cuddle, with plush rounded limbs and a child gently hugging it.
A short residential cul-de-sac ends in a circular turning area, with houses around the closed end and one access road.
A concrete culvert carries a stream beneath a road embankment, with the inlet, outlet and flowing water clearly visible.
A cumulus cloud has a flat lower base and bright rounded cauliflower-like towers, isolated against a small clear-sky margin.
Cupid is a small winged childlike mythic figure holding a bow with a heart-tipped arrow, fully clothed and nonsexual.
